cuts.head: over_shoulder
cuts.ofreeRecent: a Han-era inn — holds her keepsake at chest height; an indoor lap pool with lane ropes — swimming breaststroke; a quiet seaside tide pool bordered by smooth volcanic rock — catching a small white sunhat that has floated within reach after a light breeze; a sheltered picnic pavilion beside an ancient hillside plum orchard in clear spring daylight — laughing quietly after folding her plain white lunch napkin into a small bird; a night river covered with floating paper lanterns — holds her keepsake at chest height; her living room with a deep sofa — standing; her private chamber in a Han-era residence — standing; the Zhuge Liang shrine on the Wuzhang Plains plateau — standing; a riverside pavilion tower over the Yangtze — holds a gourd-shaped wine flask on a red cord by its cord at chest height; a hydroponic bathing pool aboard a starship — dries her hair with a towel; a sunny beach with wet sand and shallow surf — standing; a stairwell landing with a tall window — standing with one foot up on a step; an open pavilion floating above a sea of clouds at sunrise — standing
